description:
RSSParser#check_entity_expansion_risk and XMLStreamingParser#perform_xxe_check implement nearly identical checks.

Inconsistency: DOM version checks MAX_ENTITY_DEFINITIONS, streaming checks 2x that value.

Fix: Extract shared EntityExpansionGuard module with single implementation and configurable threshold.
title: Duplicated XXE/entity expansion check logic in RSSParser and XMLStreamingParser
